components.name: Filling
directions: Heat 2½ cups milk in a double boiler until boiling.
In a bowl, mix 1/2 cup milk, sugar, egg yolks, and cornstarch until smooth.
Slowly pour mixture into the boiling milk in the double boiler, stirring constantly until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in butter, vanilla, and sliced bananas.

components.name: Meringue
directions: Beat egg whites until stiff. Add sugar and vanilla.
Bake at 400°F until meringue is golden brown.
